title: ‘New!’ Badge in Application Launcher not cleared when Remember opened documents is disabled
line: Launching a newly installed app from the Application Launcher now removes its New! badge even when Recent Files history is turned off.
explanation: Since the launcher started relying on the activity manager to notice app launches, the New! badge was only cleared when kactivitymanagerd emitted ResourceScoreUpdated for the app. With 'Remember opened documents' set to 'Do not remember', the scoring plugin ignores launches, so the signal never comes and the badge stays until it expires after three days. The change factors the clearing code into RootModel::clearNewlyInstalledApp() and also calls it from AppEntry::run() when an app is launched from the menu, so launches from Kickoff/Kicker (lists, categories, favorites) clear the badge regardless of the history setting.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: clear the New! badge when launching an app from the menu

The badge was only cleared when the activity manager reported a new score
for the app, which never happens when history is disabled in the Recent
Files settings. Launching an app from the menu now clears it directly.

BUG: 506876

media.caption: Pure master, history set to 'Do not remember': the new app 'Zz New Test 2' shows New!
Pure master: after launching it from Kickoff and reopening, New! is still there
With the fix, same setting: the new app 'Zz New Test' shows New!
With the fix: after launching it from Kickoff and reopening, the badge and the Utilities dot are gone
